_about: Demo claims matching design/Main.dc.html (task A2). Loaded once on first start by task B1. All people, orders, payment IDs, photos and AI findings are mock. Times are offsets from the moment the seed is loaded; see _loader.

_loader.times: Any field ending in HoursAgo becomes an ISO timestamp (now − hours). deliveredHoursAgo → deliveredAt, submittedHoursAgo → submittedAt, hoursAgo on messages/decision/inspection/refund → at, capturedHoursAgo → capturedAt.
_loader.derived: Compute decisionDueAt = submittedAt + policy.responseDays; pickupDueAt = decision.at + policy.pickupDays (approve_return only); inspectionDueAt = return.receivedAt + policy.inspectionDays.
_loader.defaults: Fill as newClaim does: paymentStatus 'captured', policy snapshot, excluded false, refund null, inspection null, refundHistory [], audit [], version 1. Give each message an id. Refund ids: rfnd_mock_<claim number>.
_loader.assessment: Do not run analyse() on seed claims at load. Build claim.assessment from assessmentFixture with mode 'simulated' and assessedAt = the fixture's hoursAgo. Until B4 ships, map it to the current shape: recommendation (needs_judgement → request_info), rationale, observations → array of text, uncertainty, authenticity {result:'inconclusive', details}. Rule checks (window, category) are computed by the server, never taken from the fixture.
_loader.evidence: fixture: true means an illustration, not a real customer upload. image is a path under public/ that the server must serve (C1 creates the files; B1 adds the static route for /media/*.svg).
_loader.audit: Write one audit entry per seeded event (claim created, assistant request, customer reply, decision, return stages, inspection, refund) so the tracking timeline has history.

messages.text: The lamp base has a crack running up from the bottom. I noticed it when I unpacked it today. The box looked fine from outside.

Thanks, Ananya. The photo is a little blurry near the base, so the crack isn't clear yet. Could you send (1) a close-up of the crack in good light and (2) one photo of the whole lamp? This helps us resolve your request faster. If you can't take these photos, reply and a person will review your request.
messages.askedBecause: Damage claims need a clear close-up and a full view (policy §3.2)

messages.text: Here you go, close-up and the full lamp.

assessmentFixture.headline: Approve the return. Refund after inspection.
assessmentFixture.rationale: Claimed on day 2, inside the 7-day damage window. The close-up shows a crack that matches the customer's description. Because the photos can't show when the damage happened, the policy requires inspection before the refund is released.
needsJudgement: Transit or after delivery? The customer says the box looked undamaged. If you suspect courier damage, consider raising it with your logistics partner.

observations.text: A hairline crack runs about 6 cm up from the bottom edge of the ceramic base (photo 2).
Colour (sage) and shape match the ordered item (photo 3).
The crack's location matches the customer's description: "running up from the bottom".
When the damage happened. The photos can't show whether it occurred in transit or after delivery.

aiChecks.facts: No signs of use in photo 3. Confirm at inspection.
